```cypher
MATCH (p:Plugin {component: 'local_agentdetect'})<-[:MAINTAINS]-(m:Maintainer)
OPTIONAL MATCH (m)-[:MAINTAINS]->(otherPlugin:Plugin)
WHERE otherPlugin.component <> p.component
RETURN p.component, m.display_name AS maintainer_name, COLLECT(DISTINCT otherPlugin.component) AS other_maintained_plugins
LIMIT 100
```
